fields.story_title: Labs rarely lose time at the analyzer. They lose it between people.
fields.story_text:
In a diagnostic lab, one test passes through many hands. The front desk registers the patient, a phlebotomist collects the sample, a technician runs and validates it, a doctor reviews and signs, and someone sends the report.

When each of those steps lives in a different register, spreadsheet, or phone call, the work itself is not the problem. The handoffs are. Samples get searched for, results get retyped, and patients call to ask whether their report is ready.

Labora exists to close those gaps: one patient case that every role works in, with the status of every sample visible to everyone who needs it.
fields.quote_text: The analyzer is rarely the bottleneck. The wait is almost always in the handoff between two people.
fields.quote_link_label: From our guide to cutting turnaround time
fields.journey_text: Each person sees the step that is theirs, and everyone sees where the case stands.

journey_steps.title: Front desk
journey_steps.text: Registers the patient, tests, and payment on one screen.

journey_steps.title: Collection
journey_steps.text: Labels each tube at the point of collection. Home visits are tracked on a live map.

journey_steps.title: Lab
journey_steps.text: Scans every sample into a rack and slot, with a turnaround timer on every case.

journey_steps.title: Reporting
journey_steps.text: Uses templates for pathology, radiology, and ECG. Reports release after an authorized doctor signs.

journey_steps.title: Delivery
journey_steps.text: Sends the signed PDF to the patient and the referring doctor the moment it is approved.

beliefs.title: Time is a patient outcome.
beliefs.text: A faster report means an earlier answer for a patient and their doctor. We judge our product by the minutes it removes from a lab's day.

beliefs.title: One record, entered once.
beliefs.text: Every role works in the same patient case, so nothing is retyped, and nothing is lost between a register, a spreadsheet, and a phone call.

beliefs.title: Fit the lab, not the other way around.
beliefs.text: Tests, price lists, report templates, and workflows are set up to match how each lab already works, so teams keep their habits and lose the paperwork.

beliefs.title: Trust is shown, not claimed.
beliefs.text: Role-based access, audit trails, and signed releases make every action visible to the people responsible for it. See how we protect patient data.
